description: This file contains utility functions for rendering UI components such as form headers, footers, module titles, and popup headers/footers in a CRM system, specifically for the Vtiger CRM platform.

methods.name: get_left_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for the left pane form header with a given title.

methods.name: get_left_form_footer
methods.description: Returns HTML for the left pane form footer.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for a form header with optional additional text and help links.

methods.name: get_form_footer
methods.description: Placeholder function for form footer HTML (currently empty).

methods.name: get_module_title
methods.description: Creates HTML for displaying a module title with optional help and print links.

methods.name: insert_popup_header
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the start of a popup window, including theme styles.

methods.name: insert_popup_footer
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the end of a popup window.
